title: The web server must implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.
check_content:
Verify the web server is configured to implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.

If the web server is not configured to implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the web server to implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.
VulnDiscussion: Automated mechanisms for centralized reviews and analyses include security information and event management products.
